item.title: Why is D called David in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2?
item.description: D, the netrunner in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, is also called David. Here is who he is, why the name matters, and how he mirrors David Martinez from the first series. Spoilers.

item.title: Gifts for Dave: 30 gift ideas for anyone called Dave or David
item.description: The best gifts for someone called Dave or David: personalised, funny and last-minute ideas, sorted by type of Dave and by budget, from a $6 gift membership to a trip to Florence.

item.title: What does the name Dave mean? Is Dave short for David?
item.description: Yes, Dave is short for David, a Hebrew name usually translated as "beloved". Here is where the name comes from, how it spread, and how Dave became the default nickname.

item.title: How many Davids are there in the world? The name David in numbers
item.description: About 13.4 million people worldwide are called David, making it the 13th most common first name on Earth. Plus a century of US data: number one in 1960, 31st in 2024.

item.title: Famous Daves: the most notable people called Dave and David
item.description: From David Bowie and David Attenborough to Dave Grohl and Michelangelo's statue: the notable Daves in music, TV, film, art, sport and history.

item.title: David in Welsh is Dafydd: David in other languages, from Dewi to Dawud
item.description: David in Welsh is Dafydd (said "DAH-vith"), or Dewi for Saint David, and Dai for short. Plus David in Scottish Gaelic, Italian, Polish, Arabic, Hawaiian and more.

item.title: When is St David's Day 2027? Monday 1 March, plus 10 facts about Saint David
item.description: St David's Day is on 1 March every year; in 2027 that's a Monday. What the day is, 10 facts about Saint David, why the Welsh wear daffodils and leeks, and how to celebrate.
